verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS compliance and security platform with an API and MCP docs section, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question. However, no evidence shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every one, and the docs mention only service keys and an MCP server.
